players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him on injured reserve (thumb) as of 1:56 PM PT Nov 5. Earlier: Jackson (right thumb) is ruled out for Thursday night vs. Jacksonville (Nov. 5), and coach Jesse Minter confirmed he needs surgery, with an IR stint expected that could end his season. Baltimore is finalizing a trade for Jacoby Brissett to start while he is out.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: Reports on Nov. 4 say the Ravens are finalizing a trade for Brissett from Arizona, where he had dropped to third string. He won't be available for Thursday's game but is expected to start Week 10 vs. the Chargers on Monday night.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: The Eagles will start Milton over Tanner McKee in Week 9 vs. the Giants, per reports on Nov. 4. Philadelphia lost all three of McKee's starts, and Milton's rushing gives him streamer upside with a wide range of outcomes.

players.name: Tanner McKee
players.note: McKee was benched for Joe Milton ahead of Week 9 (reported Nov. 4) after going 0-3 as the starter in place of Jalen Hurts.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: Mike Macdonald said Nov. 4 that Darnold is out for Week 9 vs. Arizona with a quad injury and also cracked a rib in Week 8. He is week to week and will not go on IR; Drew Lock (elbow) is expected to start.

players.name: Jalen Milroe
players.note: With Sam Darnold out for Week 9 (quad, ruled out Nov. 4), Milroe is the Seahawks' backup behind Drew Lock, who has an elbow injury and was limited in practice. Milroe would start vs. Arizona if Lock can't play.

players.name: Deshaun Watson
players.note: The Browns announced Nov. 4 that Watson is in the concussion protocol after reporting symptoms from a hit in Week 8 at Pittsburgh. His Week 9 availability vs. New Orleans is in serious doubt.

players.name: Shedeur Sanders
players.note: With Deshaun Watson in the concussion protocol (announced Nov. 4), Sanders is next up and in line to make his first 2026 start in Week 9 vs. the Saints, with Dillon Gabriel as backup.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: Murray's sore hamstring keeps his status for Monday night vs. Buffalo (Nov. 9) unresolved, and the Vikings' first practice of the week is Thursday, Nov. 5. Carson Wentz would start if Murray is limited or out.

players.name: Gardner Minshew II
players.note: Minshew is confirmed as Arizona's Week 9 starter at Seattle, and Jacoby Brissett's pending trade to Baltimore (reported Nov. 4) clears his path. Rookie Carson Beck (back) is the backup.

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.note: Jones remains the Colts' Week 9 starter vs. Dallas, but Adam Schefter floated him as a possible trade candidate (Ravens and Vikings mentioned) ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline amid an Indianapolis fire sale. Baltimore's Brissett deal makes the Ravens less likely.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.note: On Nov. 4 Klint Kubiak said the Jeanty/Mike Washington Jr. carry split will be decided week to week; he said Jeanty can 'absolutely' be a bell cow, but a timeshare looks likely until Jeanty runs better. After 2 carries but 3 catches for 64 yards in Week 8, Jeanty projects mainly as the passing-down back for Week 9 at San Francisco.

players.name: Mike Washington Jr.
players.note: Washington started Week 8 (Nov. 1) and took 25 carries for 83 yards. On Nov. 4 Kubiak said the split with Ashton Jeanty will be set week to week, which leaves Washington as the early-down favorite for Week 9 at San Francisco.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Tuten (ankle/foot) did not practice all week and is officially questionable for TNF at Baltimore tonight (Nov. 5). Liam Coen calls him a game-time decision, though Coen said Tuten told him he feels better.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: Rodriguez (hand) has no game designation for TNF at Baltimore tonight (Nov. 5) and would likely lead Jacksonville's backfield if Bhayshul Tuten (questionable, no practice all week) sits.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Skattebo (hamstring) missed Wednesday's practice (Nov. 4), and John Harbaugh still calls him day-to-day ahead of Sunday vs. Philadelphia. Devin Singletary would start if he sits.

players.name: Devin Singletary
players.note: Singletary would likely lead the Giants' backfield Sunday vs. Philadelphia, with Cam Skattebo (hamstring) missing Wednesday's practice (Nov. 4) and Tyrone Tracy Jr. on IR.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Barkley (hamstring/back) missed Wednesday's practice (Nov. 4) after playing only 22 snaps in Week 8. Elijah Mitchell and Jaydon Blue could take on more work Sunday vs. the Giants.

players.name: Elijah Mitchell
players.note: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) missed Wednesday's practice (Nov. 4) after a 22-snap Week 8, so Mitchell could see more work Sunday vs. the Giants.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.note: McCaffrey (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday (Nov. 4) despite Kyle Shanahan's optimism that he would play in Week 9 vs. Las Vegas after the bye. Thursday and Friday practice reports will decide it.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:57 PM PT Nov 5. Earlier: Hall (quad) was limited Wednesday (Nov. 4), and Aaron Glenn said he is trending toward returning Sunday vs. Kansas City after five straight inactive games.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: Breece Hall (quad) was limited Wednesday (Nov. 4) and is trending toward returning Sunday vs. Kansas City, per Aaron Glenn, which would cut into Allen's lead role.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Week 9 vs. the Chargers (per PFT, Nov. 4) and will miss a third straight game.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: With David Montgomery (groin) ruled out for Week 9 (Nov. 4), Marks will lead Houston's backfield again Sunday vs. the Chargers.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Henderson (illness) sat out Wednesday's practice (Nov. 4), so he is no lock to play Sunday vs. Green Bay.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) missed Wednesday's practice (Nov. 4), so Stevenson could see extra work Sunday vs. Green Bay if Henderson is limited or out.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Monangai (thumb/toe) did not practice Wednesday (Nov. 4) after missing Week 8, in which D'Andre Swift had 27 carries and 3 TDs.

players.name: D'Andre Swift
players.note: With Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) missing Wednesday's practice (Nov. 4), Swift is in line to lead Chicago again after 27 carries and 3 TDs on Nov. 2 at Seattle.

players.name: Jonathan Taylor
players.note: The Colts (2-6) are in active talks to trade Taylor before the Nov. 10 deadline, per Rapoport and Schefter, and are seeking a package like the 2022 McCaffrey trade. They have already turned down a 2027 second-round pick plus another pick. The Giants, Broncos, Packers, Vikings, Seahawks and reportedly the Bengals are interested.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.note: Indianapolis is actively shopping Jonathan Taylor before the Nov. 10 deadline, and a trade would make McGowan the Colts' lead back.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Coleman out-snapped J.K. Dobbins 40-14 on Nov. 1 vs. Kansas City, with 104 total yards and a TD. He is Denver's lead back while RJ Harvey (knee) is on IR. Denver is also linked to Jonathan Taylor trade talks.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Dobbins played only 14 snaps to Jonah Coleman's 40 on Nov. 1, with 7 carries for 13 yards, and has lost Denver's lead role.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) has been on short-term IR since Oct. 31, and Jonah Coleman's 40-snap breakout on Nov. 1 threatens his role when he returns.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Arizona placed Love on IR on Nov. 3 with a high ankle sprain, and reports say he will miss 4-5 weeks.

players.name: Tyler Allgeier
players.note: With Jeremiyah Love on IR (4-5 weeks, placed Nov. 3), Allgeier leads Arizona's backfield after scoring twice in the Nov. 1 OT win at Dallas.

players.name: Zonovan Knight
players.note: Knight (concussion) is questionable and must clear protocol before Week 9. With Jeremiyah Love on IR, a healthy Knight would be the No. 2 behind Tyler Allgeier.

players.name: Jadarian Price
players.note: Price led Seattle with 10 carries in his Nov. 2 return from IR, ahead of Zach Charbonnet's 6, so Seattle's backfield looks like a committee.

players.name: Ollie Gordon II
players.note: Gordon played 80% of Miami's snaps for a second straight week on Nov. 1 and is the clear lead back while De'Von Achane is on IR.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: Pollard played 82% of Tennessee's snaps in Week 8 (Nov. 1) with Tyjae Spears (knee) out.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Spears (knee) missed Week 8 (Nov. 1) and is listed as out, with no return timeline reported.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Dave Canales said Nov. 2 that Brooks (core-muscle surgery, out since Week 2) could 'potentially' be designated to return from IR this week. No activation had been reported as of Nov. 4.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: Randall (neck) was designated to return from IR and is listed as questionable for TNF vs. Jacksonville tonight (Nov. 5).

players.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
players.note: Robinson (hamstring) is questionable after missing two straight games without practicing, and Atlanta elevated Khalil Herbert as Bijan Robinson's backup.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Kamara is listed as questionable (back) for Week 9 as of Nov. 4.

players.name: Kenny Gainwell
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:58 PM PT Nov 5. Earlier: Gainwell is listed as questionable (hip) for Week 9 as of Nov. 4, after splitting snaps 30-30 with Bucky Irving on Nov. 1.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown (ankle, knee) did not practice Wednesday (Nov 4) after sitting out last Thursday and Friday and missing Week 8. Mike Vrabel's 'we'll see' on Monday left his Week 9 status vs. Green Bay unclear.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Garrett Wilson entered the concussion protocol and did not practice Nov 4, so Mitchell (7-142-1 in Week 8) and rookie Omar Cooper Jr. would lead the Jets' receivers at Kansas City if Wilson sits.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.note: With Terry McLaurin out for the season, Williams led Washington in routes, targets and catches in the Nov 1 win over Philadelphia. He is the Commanders' WR2 behind Stefon Diggs going into Week 9.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: Douglas tied for Miami's team lead with six targets in Week 8 (Nov 1) and is a Week 9 waiver option ahead of Sunday's game vs. Detroit.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate (shoulder) missed Week 8, and Tennessee is on bye in Week 9. Per Paul Kuharsky (Nov 3-4), he is expected back for Week 10 vs. Jacksonville on Nov 15.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.note: Watson (ribs) was limited in Wednesday's practice (Nov 4) after getting hurt in Week 8 vs. Carolina. His Week 9 status vs. New England has not been decided.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Moore is listed questionable on Buffalo's Week 9 report as of Nov 4. With Josh Palmer hurting his hamstring Nov 1, Moore could see more targets if he plays.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (quad) is listed doubtful for Week 9 as of Nov 4 after missing Week 8. The injury is a recurrence of the quad problem that cost him Weeks 3-5.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday (Nov 4) and has not practiced since Week 6. He is trending toward missing another game, which would leave Makai Lemon and Dallas Goedert as Philadelphia's top targets.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel (hamstring) did not practice Nov 4, and Kyle Shanahan said Wednesday that he is not as close to returning as Mike Evans. Some outlets call him unlikely for Week 9.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:58 PM PT Nov 5. Earlier: Egbuka (foot) did not practice Wednesday (Nov 4) but ran on the side. He has missed two straight games and is uncertain for Week 9 at Chicago.

players.name: Garrett Wilson
players.note: Wilson was placed in the concussion protocol Monday after a helmet-to-helmet hit in the Week 8 loss to the Raiders. He did not practice Nov 4, and Aaron Glenn calls him day-to-day for Sunday at Kansas City.

players.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
players.note: St. Brown (ribs) was limited at Wednesday's walkthrough (Nov 4). He briefly left the Week 8 game but returned to finish with 7 catches for 46 yards, and Detroit plays at Miami on Sunday.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Pickens (hamstring) is questionable for Week 9 vs. Indianapolis as of Nov 4. The Athletic reported that his hamstring has been tightening up during games, and he had 2 catches for 48 yards in Week 8.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Boston (calf) was limited in Wednesday's practice (Nov 4) before Cleveland's Week 9 game at New Orleans.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.note: The Athletic's Jonathan Jones reports Jacksonville has 'been firm' that it is not seeking to trade Thomas and would want at least a Day 2 pick. Mike Florio reports he is Kansas City's top target, with Pittsburgh and Washington also linked before the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (calf) as of 2:57 PM PT Nov 5. Earlier: A reported trade to San Francisco fell apart, and Tom Pelissero predicts Jennings stays in Minnesota because he wants to remain there. He is still mentioned as a candidate to be moved before the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: Bernard is Pittsburgh's WR2 with Michael Pittman Jr. on IR, but the Steelers are on bye in Week 9 and are linked to a receiver trade (for example, Brian Thomas Jr.) before the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: A.J. Brown missed practice again Nov 4 and Romeo Doubs is on IR, so Douglas remains one of New England's few healthy targets. Week 9 waiver lists name him as an add.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: Lamar Jackson (thumb) is out and likely done for the season, and Tyler Huntley is also unavailable. Undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano is expected to start tonight (Nov 5) vs. Jacksonville, which hurts Lane's outlook.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Sarratt is off the injury report, but Lamar Jackson is out and likely done for the season, and undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano is expected to start tonight (Nov 5) vs. Jacksonville. That drags down Baltimore's passing outlook.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams remains on IR with a ruptured hamstring. Sean McVay has given a 6-10 week timeline, and CBS lists an expected return around Week 12.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce remains on IR with a heel injury, and Indianapolis has not yet opened his practice window.

players.name: Jayden Higgins
players.note: Higgins is on IR with a season-ending ACL injury.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson (hamstring) was a limited participant in Wednesday's Nov 4 practice, his first after missing New Orleans' first seven games. A Week 9 debut is possible if the Saints activate him from IR.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Kyle Shanahan said Evans (Achilles/ribs) would not practice Wednesday, Nov 4, and he is listed questionable for Week 9. He has not played since leaving the Oct 19 game.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:56 PM PT Nov 5. Earlier: Rice was limited in Wednesday's Nov 4 practice with hamstring and knee injuries ahead of Week 9 against the Jets. He had 18.3 PPR points in his Week 8 return.

players.name: Rashid Shaheed
players.note: Shaheed (knee) remains questionable after missing the Nov 2 MNF game. One Week 9 injury preview (Nov 4) lists him as likely out.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson (multiple broken ribs, suffered Nov 1) is still expected to play through it. Arizona put Kendrick Bourne on IR on Nov 3, so Wilson's target share should grow.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring) missed the Week 8 loss on Nov 1. No Week 9 practice participation had been reported as of Nov 4.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Baltimore was reported on Nov 4 to be finalizing a trade for QB Jacoby Brissett from Arizona. With Lamar Jackson possibly done for the season, that should be an upgrade over rookie Joe Fagnano for Flowers; the Ravens play Jacksonville tonight.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: Rashee Rice is back, and Kansas City is still expected to pursue a receiver before the Nov 10 trade deadline (ESPN, Nov 2-3). Either one would push Worthy further down the target pecking order.

players.name: Skyler Bell
players.note: Bills WR Joshua Palmer left the Week 8 game with a hamstring injury, which could open snaps for Bell, a healthy scratch on Nov 1. No Palmer update had been reported as of Nov 4.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) has been on IR since Oct 19 and is out at least through Week 10.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19 and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: Henry (foot) did not practice Wednesday, Nov 4, after leaving the Week 8 win at Miami, and remains questionable for Sunday vs. Green Bay. Reports lean toward him missing Week 9.

players.name: Eli Raridon
players.note: With Hunter Henry (foot) sitting out Wednesday's Nov 4 practice and trending toward missing Week 9 vs. Green Bay, Raridon (92% snaps in Week 8) projects as New England's lead TE. Several Week 9 waiver lists flag him as a potential every-week starter while Henry is out.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (low-ankle sprain) did not practice Wednesday, Nov 4, and worked with trainers. He is questionable for Sunday at Indianapolis with Thursday and Friday practices left to show progress; Brevyn Spann-Ford would lead the TEs if he sits.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:56 PM PT Nov 5. Earlier: Kelce (ankle) was limited in Wednesday's Nov 4 practice, which reports view as likely maintenance. He played through it in Week 8 (5-67 on 7 targets) and has two more chances to practice fully before Sunday vs. the Jets.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: The Rams opened Ferguson's 21-day return window on Nov 4, and he was limited in his first practice back from his ankle injury. A Week 9 return vs. Washington is considered optimistic, and he would join a crowded TE rotation with Higbee, Allen and Klare.

players.name: Mark Andrews
players.note: Andrews (hand) practiced fully and has no designation for TNF on Nov 5, but undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano starts at QB with Lamar Jackson out. Baltimore is trading for Jacoby Brissett, who is expected to start in Week 10, so Andrews' QB quality is down for the near term.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as NYG's starting QB as of 8:03 AM PT Nov 4.

players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (quadriceps) as of 1:57 PM PT Nov 4.

players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as NYG's backup QB as of 8:03 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Matthew Stafford
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:19 PM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Stafford is dealing with an arm injury, and Sean McVay said he will defer to Stafford on how he feels ahead of Sunday. The Rams' first Week 9 injury report comes Wednesday, Nov. 4.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:01 PM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Meyers was limited on Monday's (Nov 2) estimated practice report with hamstring and ankle injuries, and he is listed questionable.
